reason: The plugin is primarily a web search integration for DeepSeek Harness, registering a Tavily-backed provider (`tavily`) and exposing configuration in the settings UI to enable/disable it and supply credentials. This evidence places the primary purpose in search/browsing capability rather than code generation or automation, with limited scope concentrated on provider wiring and configuration.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供基于 Tavily 的网络搜索提供者，并在设置界面提供 API Key 填写与开关控制。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a Tavily-backed web search provider to DeepSeek Harness and provides a settings UI card with API key input and an enable/disable switch.

capabilities: web search provider integration via Tavily API
GUI-based toggle and API key configuration for the provider
network requests to an external service for query execution
reading credentials from harness credential/config sources
